name: red-far-safety-park
title: DRAFT Auto: Red Far Safety (Leave + Park, unmeasured)
description: DRAFT safety auto, 2026-11-21. No shooting: leave the start area and park. Red frame: left side on the far wall, facing +X (toward the centre line), front exactly on the centre line. Back straight off the wall, then toward the red wall holding heading, and park with only the rear-right corner (about 3 x 3 in) inside the red loading zone and nothing touching a wall. No delay. Blue mirror (BlueAudienceSafetyParkAutonomous): audience wall on the left, facing red, park with one corner in the blue loading zone. The preload stays in the robot.

pose.provenance: DERIVED from the measured 396 x 374 mm chassis (15.591 x 14.724 in, robot.json). Facing +X, left side on the far wall (y = 72 - 14.724 / 2 = 64.638) and the FRONT exactly on the centre line (x = -15.591 / 2 = -7.796, the front edge at -0.0007 in, not over it); the team confirmed this is how the robot is placed. robot.json's expanded length was set to the chassis length on 2026-11-21 so this validates; the depollinator is stowed here and never deployed. Blue mirror (7.796, -64.638, 180 deg). Assumes the Pinpoint tracking point is the chassis centre (robot.json caveat).

steps.notes: Pull straight off the wall first (first control point at the start x) (clears flower1's foot behind, x -27 to -21), then back toward the red wall holding heading. End pose (-56.2, 52.36, 0 deg): the rear-right corner sits at (-64.0, 45.0), 3 in inside the loading zone's corner (x < -61, y < 48); the other three corners are outside it. Blue mirror (56.2, -52.36, 180 deg), corner at (64.0, -45.0).
